name: windowed match similarity
mechanism: count characters that match within a window proportional to the shorter length, count transpositions among the matches, combine into a similarity, and boost when the prefixes agree

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Jaro–Winkler distance' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Approximate sequence matching: is a measure of similarity between two strings

requires: a window size rule and a prefix bonus (policy)
